metadata.name: Cover Flow
metadata.description: A cinematic cover flow on a rounded black stage: covers turn in perspective, fade into the floor and glide between positions with a soft spring. Drag, scroll, click or use the arrow keys; bring your own images or use the ten built-in covers drawn in code. More like this, plus a designer your coding agent can use, at studios.lou15.com/?ref=21st
metadata.author: louisstudios
